collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — FEARS AND DOUBTS (FEA-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fears big and small, sensible and not, self-doubt, feeling like a fraud, dread with no reason, wanting and fearing the same thing, and courage that is still frightened. Nobody has to be brave, nobody is mocked, and a fear does not have to be conquered by the end.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A villager new to a job keeps dropping things while an expert watches: ask for help, or keep going quietly.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has just started new work, and everyone around (subject.him/her) seems to know what they're doing. Their hands move without thinking. (subject)'s hands feel like somebody else's: slow, clumsy, always dropping things. Today (subject.he/she) has dropped the same thing three times, and (friend), who has done this work for years, is watching.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: "I'm doing it wrong," says (subject). "Show me again?" (friend) shows (subject.him/her), slowly. Then again. Then (friend.he/she) says, "I dropped it about a hundred times when I started. My teacher called me Butter Fingers for a year." (subject) laughs. It doesn't make (subject.his/her) hands faster. It makes (subject.him/her) feel less alone in them.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) picks it up and keeps going. (subject.He/she) drops it again. And again. By the end of the day, (subject.he/she) has dropped it fewer times. Not none. Fewer. (subject.He/she) goes home tired and doubtful and comes back the next morning anyway. That's all there is to it, some days.
